@skipkayhil — gentle ping in case my earlier reply got buried. Short version: PK exclusion from `indexes()` is intentional and consistent across PG/MySQL/SQLite (PG since 2005), and `indexes()` feeds the schema dumper, so changing it would require coordinated changes to all three adapters plus the dumper. Short-circuiting `find_unique_index_for` when `unique_by` is nil felt like the narrower fix. Happy to take the adapter-level path instead if you'd prefer — just let me know.
